AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JULY 31, 2025 AT 2:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 31, 2025 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July 24, 2025,
  on the bulletin board outside City Hall.
 3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting held on May 27, 2025.

5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council

6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the FY 2025 External Audit Engagement
  Overview – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager
  b. Internal Audit Activity Report as of June 30, 2025 – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal
  Internal Auditor
  c. FY 2025 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2026 Audit Work Plan – Natalie
  Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 31, 2025

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:02 PM
  Present: Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Alex Parajon
  Absent: Christopher Satoorian
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  a. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of July 31, 2025, was posted on
  July 24, 2025, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  Speaker: Herbert Molano

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  a. Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting held on May 27, 2025
  Moved: Denise Miller  Seconded: Jack Mavyan
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Alex Parajon
  Noes: None
  Absent: Christopher Satoorian
  Abstain: None

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  Committee Member Zareh Davidian nominated Committee Member Alex
  Parajon.
  Speaker: Herbert Molano.
  Committee Member Jack Mavyan nominated Committee Member Denise Miller.

  1
   A roll call vote was conducted, with each member stating their vote as follows:

  •  Zareh Davidian: Voted for Mr. Parajon
  •  Jack Mavyan: Voted for Ms. Miller
  •  Denise Miller: Voted for Ms. Miller
  •  Alex Parajon: Voted for Mr. Parajon
  The result was a tie vote (2-2). The election was continued to the next meeting
  when all five members are present.
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  Chair Alex Parajon nominated staff from the Management Services Department
  (MSD) to continue providing staff support as Secretary of the Audit Committee.
  No other nominations were made.

  Nominated: MSD Staff  Seconded: Jack Mavyan
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Alex Parajon
  Noes: None
  Absent: Christopher Satoorian
  Abstain: None

  c. Annual Report to City Council
  Chair Alex Parajon read the Annual Report to City Council into the record.

  Moved: Denise Miller  Seconded: Zareh Davidian
  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Zareh Davidian, Jack Mavyan, Denise Miller, Alex Parajon
  Noes: None
  Absent: Christopher Satoorian
  Abstain: None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  a. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the FY 2025 External Audit
  Engagement Overview – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager
  Speaker: Herbert Molano.

  Mr. Joe Ludin, Principal at CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP, presented the FY 2025
  External Audit Engagement Overview to the Audit Committee and answered
  questions from the Committee members.

  2
   b. Internal Audit Activity Report as of June 30, 2025 – Natalie Minami-
  Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor
  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, provided a report to the
  Audit Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on June 30,
  2025.
  Mr. Daniel Mitchell presented the Take-Home Vehicle Audit and answered
  questions from the Committee members.
  Mr. Mitchell presented the PCI Compliance Audit and answered questions from
  the Committee members.
  Speaker: Herbert Molano.
  Following the audit presentations, Ms. Minami-Valdivia continued presenting the
  Internal Audit activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress,
  continuous audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and
  advisory services and answered questions from the Committee members.
  c. FY 2025 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2026 Audit Work
  Plan – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor
  Ms. Minami-Valdivia presented a report to the Audit Committee on the FY 2025
  Audit Work Plan Status Update and the FY 2026 Proposed Audit Work Plan and
  answered questions from the Committee members.
  Speaker: Herbert Molano.
7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Ms. Minami-Valdivia introduced the new Director of Finance, Mr. Jack Liang, who
  addressed the Audit Committee briefly. She also recognized the hard work of Mr.
  Mitchell and thanked all Audit Committee members for their dedicated service
  and support.
8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  Committee Member Denise Miller requested that a future agenda include a
  discussion on the frequency of Audit Committee meetings.
9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Alex Parajon  Seconded: Denise Miller
  Adjournment at 3:39 PM
